newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tung Fong Hung terminates disposal talk.
newsitem.headline: Tung Fong Hung terminates disposal talk.

text.p: Chinese medicine retailer Tung Fong Hung (Holdings) Ltd has terminated discussions on the sale of its 29.09 percent stake in Nam Pei Hong (Holding) Ltd, the companies said in a joint statement on Tuesday.
"The discussion has been terminated and there is no other ongoing negotiation as such," the statement said.
Tung Fong Hung will continue to work with financial advisors towards the formulation of possible plans to rationalise the business of both Tung Fong Hung and Nam Pei Hong, it said.
Nam Pei Hong is also a retailer of Chinese medicines and health foods retailer and manufacturer.
